notes: Univariate location submodel with identity link.
Univariate scale submodel with log link.
Random intercepts (1 | group) and random intercept + one slope (1 + x | group) on the mu submodel; nested / crossed / RE-on-sigma still planned.
Student-t location submodel with identity link.
Student-t scale submodel with log link.
Student-t degrees-of-freedom submodel with log(nu - 2) link; nu > 2 required for finite variance.
Lognormal location submodel: mu is the mean of log(Y), identity link.
Lognormal scale submodel: sigma is the SD of log(Y), log link.
Gamma location submodel (positive continuous response, default log link via stats::Gamma(link = "log")).
Gamma dispersion submodel on the log scale.
Beta location submodel: mu in (0, 1) via the logit link; response Y in (0, 1).
Beta precision submodel on the log scale (larger sigma -> tighter distribution around mu).
Poisson count submodel with log link; no dispersion parameter.
Negative binomial (type 2) count submodel with log link.
Negative binomial overdispersion submodel; variance = mu + mu^2/exp(sigma).
Bivariate Gaussian location submodel for the first response.
Bivariate Gaussian location submodel for the second response.
Bivariate Gaussian scale submodel for the first response (log link).
Bivariate Gaussian scale submodel for the second response (log link).
Residual correlation between the two responses (atanh_guarded link).
Per-trait intercept submodel via 0 + trait fixed effects.
Between-unit reduced-rank loading matrix via latent(0 + trait | unit).
Implied between-unit covariance Lambda_B Lambda_B^T (+ Psi_B when unique term present).
Per-trait unique variance via unique(0 + trait | unit).
